falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% and a competing non-bottom pattern (top, continuation, or breakdown) prints similarity above 75% on the same engine snapshot within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom analog anchoring UNKNOWN/HOLD is no longer the dominant match, so the unresolved hold is wrong and a directional verdict should have been issued

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 65 on any session within 14 days while the primary risk asset closes at a new 20-session high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff/late-cycle regime is active, which contradicts an unknown bottoming phase and a HOLD; the call should have been exhaustion or late-cycle, not UNKNOWN

falsification_conditions.condition: The primary risk asset closes more than 3% below the trough of the bottom_2024_aug analog window and stays below that level for 3 consecutive sessions within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog has failed in price; remaining UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong because the pattern is invalidated and the signal should have flipped to risk-off

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
